scope: All 36 complete values independently read and compared with the six complete English source messages. Review covers semantics, written idiom and script/Jyutping separately. It does not certify native-speaker review, screen layout, rendering, runtime behavior, historical linguistic purity or every dialect within a broad language tag. No processing-label repairs or unrelated strings reviewed or edited.

yue-Hant.scope: Written Cantonese, traditional characters. Technical nouns are standard Chinese vocabulary embedded in Cantonese syntax.

yue-Latn.scope: Jyutping with lexical tone numbers and word-separated syllables. Full romanized values checked against the corresponding complete Cantonese text, including hai2/喺 versus hai6/係, waak6/verb 畫 versus waa2/noun 畫布. This is a reading review, not audio or native-reader certification.

wuu-Hans.scope: Shanghai-style written Wu within the broad wuu tag. 搿、辣、浪、搭、个、勿 and 里向 are coherent with that style. This does not certify idiom across all Wu varieties; formal technical borrowings are retained.

lzh-Hant.scope: Modern technical Literary Chinese in traditional characters, not a claim that pixel/canvas/import terminology is ancient usage. Compressed syntax is coherent. 裁域 is read as crop region; technical register is intentionally modern.

hak-Hant-TW.scope: Taiwan Hakka traditional-character prose. 摎、个、這下、做得、頂背、毋 and 肚 supply Hakka grammar/lexicon; this is not certification across every Taiwan Hakka accent. 留等 is an attested keep/retain construction.

nan-Hant-TW.scope: Taiwanese Southern Min traditional-character prose using 佇、佮、予、會當、囥、攏、袂 and 矣. MOE lexical sources support the key directions, placement and current-time words. Not native certification.

correction_chronology.independent_resolution: Retain waak6 for the verb draw; primary lexical entry marks 畫 waak6 as 動詞/to draw/to paint. Retain waa2 in the noun 畫布. The earlier noun waa2 verb reading and tentative waa6 alternative are not accepted. No unobserved old value hash is claimed.

nonblocking_idiom_notes.note: 留咧這馬的位置 is understandable as retain the current position. MOE attests 留 as preserve/stay and 咧 as continuative; it does not certify this exact technical collocation. A fluent Taiwanese editor might prefer 保持這馬的位置. No edit is required or automatically accepted by this review.
Shanghai-style orthography is coherent and lexically supported. The generic wuu tag covers more dialects; all-Wu naturalness is not established.
裁域 is intelligible as crop region, but its idiomatic status as an established technical term is not independently established; no semantic loss is detected.

lexical_sources.supports: Verb waak6; noun waa2 distinguished within examples.
kwok3 daai6 reading and expand/enlarge sense.
Primary authored discussion by linguist 钱乃荣 of Shanghai orthography, including 搿、辣、个、勿; written locative 辣…浪 usage.
Official Hakka vocabulary, 留等 keep/retain construction.
Official Hakka 這下 current/now and localized directional vocabulary.
Taiwanese 囥 = put/store, with positional example.
Taiwanese 留 = preserve/stay; 留咧 is attested, without certifying the exact target collocation.
Taiwanese 咧 continuative after verb; contrasts with progressive use.
Taiwanese 咧 before a verb/adjective marks ongoing action, not a general locative substitute.
